_comment: Mainframe lead-in text and synergy tiers, read from the official card images at playneuroscape.com/cards on 2026-10-03. The fan database dropped the lead-ins and thresholds. 'needs' = synergy required per faction; 'mode' = how the tier combines with the previous one (base | instead | adds | or). Synthetix effect numbers come from the fan database (small text on the card); everything else was read from the card image.

tiers.text: Deal 1 [Mainframe] damage to any target.
Deal 2 [Mainframe] damage to any target.
Deal 2 [Mainframe] damage to target player.
Draw 1.
+1/+1 for each cyberware attached to them.
+2/+1 for each cyberware attached to them.
-5 PSYCHOSIS.
-10 PSYCHOSIS.
Your RAM comes into play refreshed.
On your SYSTEM CHECK, install 1 RAM refreshed.
You lose 1 [Mainframe] and 1 [Bioframe] health. Install 1 RAM running.
You lose 2 [Mainframe] and 2 [Bioframe] health. Install 2 RAM refreshed.
When you play a tether, draw 1.
When you play a [Dustrunner] character, draw 1.
MIRAGE (When character is targeted by an opponent, you may put it into its owner's hand.)
They can only be blocked by 2 or more characters.
When you play a tarot, look at the top card of your cyberdeck. You may bin it.
You may play tarots reversed.
When you play a tarot, create a [Mainframe] 0/1 Dreamwalker token character.
All Dreamwalker tokens get +1/+1.

tiers.text: +1/+1 until turn end.
+2/+2 until turn end.

tiers.text: +1/+0 until turn end.
OVERRUN until turn end. (Character deals excess damage to defending player when blocked.)

tiers.text: Put a +1/+1 counter on target character.
Put two +1/+1 counters on target character.

tiers.text: +1/+1 until turn end.
+2/+2 until turn end.

tiers.text: DIVINE 2 (Look at the top 2 cards of your cyberdeck. Put 1 into your hand, then bin the other.)
DIVINE 2 for each blocked [Mystic] or [Dustrunner].
Characters you control with [Cybernetic] gear get STAMINA. (Character doesn't run when it attacks.)
Characters you control with [Thrasher] gear get FEEDBACK. (Whenever character is dealt damage, it deals that much [Bioframe] damage to the source's controller.)

tiers.text: Once per turn, install 1 RAM running.
Install 1 RAM running.

tiers.text: For double their cost. As they resolve, purge them.
For their base cost. As they resolve, purge them.
When 1 or more non-token [Nanobot] characters you control are destroyed by an opponent, create a [Bioframe] 1/1 [Nanobot] Drone token character.
All [Nanobot] characters you control get +1/+1.
